crew.overview: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people.
crew.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves

crew.overview: In the land of Oz, ostracized and misunderstood green-skinned Elphaba is forced to share a room with the popular aristocrat Glinda at Shiz University, and the two's unlikely friendship is tested as they begin to fulfill their respective destinies as Glinda the Good and the Wicked Witch of the West.
crew.title: Wicked

crew.overview: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
crew.title: Black Widow

crew.original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
crew.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
crew.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

details.biography: Born in Dublin, Ireland. Dave is a stunt performer/actor and stunt rigger. An extensive background in martial arts and a love for film kicked off the journey to Stunts. England is where he has called home for the last few years and where he can be found working, most of the time.
details.name: Dave Boyle
